correctness.rationale: Exact F2 field enumerations for 1≤n≤9 independently yielded smooth N_n=(4,8,4,24,44,8,116,312,508) after adding the asserted eight Artin–Schreier pole points (4 over odd n, 8 over even n). Independently formed Newton coefficients (1,1,2,0,2,2,−4,−8,−11,5), then the genus-nine functional equation reconstructs the degree-18 numerator, which factors into quadratic 1−T+2T², double quadratic 1+T+2T², quartic 1−T²+4T⁴, octic 1−2T²+T⁴−8T⁶+16T⁸, and evaluates to P(1)=1024. This is exact through the genus 9 FE, not extrapolation from nine sampled degrees. The eight-simple-pole normalization and genus premise is accepted conditionally on the cited primary Proposition 7.2, which could not be independently read.
